name: Rich text editor
description: TipTap WYSIWYG for description fields. Vendored — no CDN, no npm.

settings.default: bold, italic, strike, code, h2, h3, bullet, ordered, quote, hr, link, image, gallery, html, clear, undo, redo
settings.label: Toolbar buttons
settings.help: Comma-separated, in display order. Available: bold, italic, strike, code, h1, h2, h3, bullet, ordered, quote, codeblock, hr, link, image, gallery, html, clear, undo, redo. Use | for a separator. The image and gallery buttons only appear on a record that has been saved and whose model keeps images inside its text — there is nowhere to upload to before that.

settings.label: Offer an HTML source view
settings.help: Adds a Visual/HTML toggle so the raw markup stays reachable.
